readyVersionPlatform.result: CLI minimum 0.1.5-rc.2 separated from ACP bridge 0.0.1; executable fingerprint, initialize/new/exact resume and real grouped model catalog. This artifact qualifies only macOS arm64; each machine still needs normal installation/model/Session readiness checks.

limitations: No macOS x64, Windows x64 or Linux x64 qualification is inferred.

ACP has no session/load, additionalDirectories, manual compact command, compaction lifecycle, MCP SSE/resources/prompts or client filesystem/terminal bridge. Exact resume, persistent native System prompt and native tools implement the accepted product behavior.

Overflow acceptance injects one context-window error at the official llm/stream seam and exercises the real native summarizer and automatic retry. It does not claim a naturally exhausted provider window.

Idle manual compaction has no active native turn and is not attributed to the next AgentRun. Automatic summary usage is correlated through its durable compaction/start owner. Missing token fields and cost remain unknown.
Credentials, raw prompts, local machine paths, Session IDs and Run IDs are excluded from this qualification artifact.

qualificationBasis.decision: All 14 Runtime integration axes are verified on macOS arm64; upstream ACP interface differences are accepted by V1.59-D08. This is Adapter behavior qualification, not a packaged application release or a cross-platform claim.
